descriptionHtml:
Approach · EFS Empty & Failure States · S23 Existing specs: a text AI call retries before it errors — 0, 1 and 2 Haiku failures, a non-transient error, then everything failing

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • T1 Every AI call (summary, note, billing, Ask AI, photo reading, voice transcription, handoff) retries automatically before showing an error; text calls go Haiku twice, then Mistral; … (TFA-94745 AC 4; TFA-92568 AC 5; UAT 3.5)

Test design technique: Boundary values (boundary) — Sit right on the edge of the rule (exactly on time / a minute late, empty, longest, most) and see on which side the behavior changes.

Given Tim's api specs stubbing bedrock.invoke under chat()

When Run the seven tests by title

Then No failure: Haiku answers. One temporary failure: the second Haiku try answers. Two: Mistral answers after Haiku, Haiku. A request Haiku refuses, or an unclassified error: Mistral at once, with no second Haiku try. A deployment failure: thrown at once, no retry, no fallback. All fail: the error is thrown only after Haiku, Haiku, Mistral

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): The specs' own assertions (call order and modelUsage). The PF-03-02 titles follow Daniela's DM (non-transient straight to Mistral) rather than the comment's 'Haiku twice'; that choice is Q13, and if Daniela picks the comment's rule they become Fails of T1. They cover the shared text path only; photo and voice retries are OAT-03 S18 / S19 and EFS S18. …

Where it ran: local lane A (existing Playwright tests); test method API · API (Convex functions); lane planned in the matrix: existing tests (Tim's Playwright) (automated)

S23 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/EFS.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: local — main e02167f, local stack (not a deployed build); run folder runs/2026-10-14-local, lane A.

Test method: API · API (Convex functions); secondary: FAULT · Fault injection — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on local; Source: matrix (lane A).

UAT item: EFS Empty & Failure States · Section: A5 · Cross-Cutting · Scenario: EFS/S23

Existing specs: a text AI call retries before it errors — 0, 1 and 2 Haiku failures, a non-transient error, then everything failing

Tickets: TFA-92568 Phase 4: Make it safe for real patients (in progress); TFA-94745 Empty & Failure States (ready for qa)

Result: passed in matrix/EFS.results.json (lane A: the existing Playwright specs below, run on the local stack; agent-matrix.sh).

Existing specs:

  • api/provider-fallback.spec.ts [api] — PF-03-01 primary answers — expected
  • api/provider-fallback.spec.ts [api] — PF-03-01 primary answers (twin): a Haiku throttle is retried on Haiku once, then answered by Mistral — expected
  • api/provider-fallback.spec.ts [api] — PF-03-01 primary answers (twin): the second Haiku try can answer — expected
  • api/provider-fallback.spec.ts [api] — PF-03-02 a request Haiku refuses goes straight to Mistral, with no second Haiku try — expected
  • api/provider-fallback.spec.ts [api] — PF-03-02 (twin): a deployment failure is thrown at once — no retry, no fallback — expected
  • api/provider-fallback.spec.ts [api] — PF-03-02 an unclassified error is not temporary: Mistral at once — expected
  • api/provider-fallback.spec.ts [api] — PF-03-04 both fail — expected

Dev run: skipped: local-only — local-only — Lane A (Tim's api spec e2e/api/provider-fallback.spec.ts): it stubs bedrock.invoke under chat() in-process from the QA worktree and calls no deployment, so there is nothing to run on dev; it runs with the local suite (Quinn 2026-10-14).. This local result replaces that dev entry (the scenario appears once).
